description: Create a new Nepternship account from details collected in the conversation and send a confirmation email. Use this only when the user has explicitly asked to join through the assistant and has given all required fields: email, full name, university, what they are looking for, and who they can introduce other students to. After success, call finish_signup once the user confirms their email.

career_center_referral.description: 'Were you referred by your university career center?'

city.description: Preferred location, e.g. 'Boston, MA' or 'New York'

held_opportunity_id.description: The opportunity_id of the member they tried to request an intro from before signing up, if any (from the needs_account answer)

industries.description: Up to 3 of: Academia, Arts, Business, Engineering, Entertainment, Fashion, Government, Healthcare, Law, Tech

looking_for.description: 'Expand on the type of opportunity you are looking for' in their words, at least 10 characters

offering.description: 'Who can you introduce other students to?' in their words, at least 10 characters: a specific person, their role and company, and a location if applicable

offering_industry.description: Industry of the person they can introduce (one of the ten)

referral_code.description: Friend's referral code, if they have one

university.description: University as they say it, e.g. 'NYU'

name: sign_up
title: Create a Nepternship account
